Job.JobTitle: Account Executive Officer/Senior Underwriter Inland Marine
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Underwriter, Underwriting, Insurance Account Executive
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $112,000 to $184,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Hartford, CT
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$112,000.00 - $184,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Inland Marine provides protection for business properties that are mobile in nature or require unique valuation. Coverages extend to properties that are owned or in a business's care related to construction, transportation, fine art, and renewable energy. The Account Executive Officer (AEO), Inland Marine will partner with agents and brokers to provide coverage for new and renewal business based on customers' needs. This role is seen as a technical resource. As an AEO, you are decisive, detail-oriented, and know how to build relationships internally and externally to drive results. Your ability to independently assess complex risk and sell our products in challenging markets will contribute to the profitability and success of Travelers.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned book of business.
  • Underwrite and skillfully negotiate complex customer accounts to minimize risk and maximize profitability.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales plans and identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Foster and maintain relationships with external partners by regularly meeting in person with agents and brokers to market and sell Travelers products with a goal of writing and retaining accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to such meetings.
  • Identify and capture new business opportunities using consultative marketing and sales skills.
  • Independently develop and execute agency sales plans and frequently partner with your Managing Director (MD) to develop region/group sales plans.
  • May assist in the training and mentoring of less experienced Account Executives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Six to eight years of relevant underwriting experience with experience in inland marine.
  • Deep knowledge of inland marine products, the regulatory environment, and the local insurance market.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to proactively identify underwriting, marketing, or financial challenges and analyze available information to make timely decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate in difficult situations with agents and brokers.
  • CPCU designation.

What is a Must Have?

  • Four years of underwriting, claim, operations, risk assessment, actuarial, sales, product, or finance experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

As an MD, you are strategic, decisive, detail-oriented, and know how to build relationships internally and externally to drive results. Your ability to lead others in independently assessing complex risk and sell our products in challenging markets will contribute to the profitability and success of Travelers.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of business within a location or region.
  • Partner with RVP to develop and implement business strategies to effectively achieve profit and growth objectives.
  • Effectively manage local strategies, objectives and tactics concerning relationships with brokers and agencies.
  • Underwrite and skillfully negotiate the most complex, at-risk, or hard-to-close deals.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales strategies and identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Regularly meet in person with agents and brokers and have the ability to travel to these meetings.
  • Provide strategic direction and support for team and take responsibility for coaching, training, and performance management.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Eight to ten years of relevant underwriting experience with experience in commercial lines.
  • Experience leading or managing others.
  • Prior management of a field location.
  • Expert level knowledge of Ocean Marine products, the regulatory environment, and the local insurance market.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to proactively identify underwriting, marketing, or financial challenges and analyze available information to make timely decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.

  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.

Quick facts

  • Pay: $60,000 to $109,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Hartford, CT
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

Full job description

Company Details

Berkley Healthcare is a dynamic and growing insurance organization that values creativity, collaboration, and innovation. Backed by the strength of a Fortune 500 company, we operate with the agility of a forward-thinking team and the stability of an established enterprise. We believe in empowering individuals to share ideas, challenge norms, and help shape the future of insurance. If you're eager to gain hands-on experience in a company that values fresh perspectives and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you.

www.berkleyheathcare.com

Responsibilities

The Senior Underwriter is responsible for submission generation, underwriting and policy issuance of Directors and Officers Liability, Employment Practices Liability, Fiduciary Liability, Fidelity/Crime for large and complex private commercial and not-for-profit healthcare organizations. The underwriting position will be part of the Berkley Healthcare Financial Lines division of Berkley Healthcare. While our main offices are in West Hartford, CT, Chicago, IL and Chesterfield, MO we will consider candidates nationwide. The senior underwriter will be responsible for handling new and renewal, primary and excess business throughout the placement process from underwriting submission receipt to policy issuance.

Responsibilities

  • Determine risk acceptability in accordance with underwriting risk appetite and guidelines
  • Prepare thorough underwriting analyses with detailed exposure analysis and independent underwriter assessment
  • Make pricing, coverage, terms and conditions determinations and recommendations within defined limits/authority and underwriting guidelines and authority parameters
  • Develop, grow and maintain a profitable, diversified book of business aligned with company goals
  • Ensure production and loss ratio goals are achieved for assigned book by reviewing, analyzing and evaluating information and taking appropriate action as necessary
  • Develop positive agency relationships within assigned territory while maintaining a good rapport through responsive levels of service
  • Coordinate marketing activities including travel in coordination with colleagues
  • Travel nationally up to 35% of time
  • Foster growth of less experienced staff in a positive and growth-oriented environment
  • Actively self-educate as to line of business, industry and insurance trends including exposures, claims, legal, legislative, healthcare, current events, self-improvement and innovation
  • Partner with the Medical Professional underwriting team and other Berkley operating units to identify and execute cross-selling opportunities that support strategic growth objectives.
  • Serve as a market-facing resource for brokers and internal partners, providing product expertise, market intelligence, and feedback to support distribution strategy and business development efforts.

Qualifications

Education

  • BA/BS/BBA degree from an accredited university or college

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of recent experience in financial lines underwriting, with a proven track record of success.
  • Specialized experience in healthcare financial lines underwriting is highly preferred.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of financial lines products, including coverages, policy forms, and industry standards.
  • The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Skills

  • Exceptional organizational skills, with the ability to manage complex underwriting files and maintain efficient workflow processes.
  • Strong customer service orientation, with a commitment to delivering high-quality client experiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and professionally.
  • Effective desk management capabilities, including prioritization, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated and independent, while remaining accountable to team objectives and company goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to take calculated risks and apply sound business judgment in underwriting decisions.
  • Strategic mindset, with a solid understanding of business drivers and the ability to contribute to bottom-line results.

Additional Company Details

Only solicited resumes/candidate profiles that are submitted by a Berkley Preferred Agency Partner that have been requested by Berkley Internal Recruiting to engage in a particular search will be subject to the payment of Agency fees as defined in the formal agency agreement. Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles are not subject to payment of the agency fees.

The company offers a competitive compensation plan and robust benefits package for full-time regular employees which for this role include:
• Base Salary Range: $60,000-$109,000
• Eligible to participate in annual discretionary bonus.
• Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Wellness, Paid Time Off, 401(k) and Profit-Sharing plans.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Merrill, WI
  • Experience: 3 to 5 years
  • Education: High school diploma or GED

Full job description

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior Underwriting Support Specialist is responsible for providing advanced underwriting support underwriting activities, and servicing activities while serving as a technical resource for underwriting support operations. This role supports underwriters through risk review, renewal preparation, endorsement evaluation, account servicing, and the underwriting of designated accounts of increasing size, premium volume, and complexity within established authority through risk evaluation, coverage review, and application of underwriting guidelines while promoting operational quality and customer satisfaction

The Senior Underwriting Support Specialist provides leadership through technical expertise, mentoring, training, and process improvement initiatives. The primary accountability of this role is delivering advanced underwriting support while enhancing team capability, supporting underwriting operations, and developing expertise necessary for increasingly complex underwriting responsibilities. This role serves as an advanced underwriting support position that provides opportunities to develop underwriting knowledge, technical expertise, and advanced technical, leadership, and underwriting career opportunities.


Primary Job Responsibilities

Underwriting Support & Risk Review

  • Underwrite designated renewal accounts and routine underwriting transactions of increasing size and complexity within delegated authority by evaluating risk information and applying underwriting guidelines and standards.
  • Review risk information, account characteristics, and supporting documentation to assess exposures and determine appropriate underwriting actions or recommendations.
  • Apply underwriting guidelines, coverage analysis, and rating considerations when evaluating and processing assigned underwriting responsibilities.
  • Perform designated underwriting activities for assigned accounts and other risks within established authority and guidelines, including evaluating risk information, applying underwriting guidelines, analyzing coverage considerations, and completing underwriting actions within delegated authority and established procedures.
  • Provide advanced underwriting support for renewals, endorsements, and policy servicing activities.
  • Prepare and review renewal files and supporting documentation to facilitate underwriting evaluation and decision-making.
  • Conduct review of endorsements and policy transactions within established authority and procedures, evaluating risk characteristics, coverage considerations, and appropriate underwriting actions
  • Evaluate supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, and underwriting readiness.
  • Support underwriters with increasingly complex underwriting support activities and account servicing needs.
  • Document underwriting actions, communications, and supporting information in accordance with departmental standards.

Customer Service & Collaboration

  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with producers, customers, underwriters, and internal business partners.
  • Provide timely, accurate, and professional service in support of retention, customer satisfaction, and business objectives.
  • Assist in resolving complex service issues and underwriting support concerns.
  • Collaborate with underwriters and business partners to support underwriting workflows, account servicing, and renewal processes.
  • Serve as a resource for underwriting support staff and assist with escalated questions or issues.
  • Communicate underwriting decisions, requirements, coverage considerations, and risk-related recommendations to producers, customers, underwriters, and internal business partners as appropriate.

Leadership, Mentoring & Training

  • Serve as a technical resource and experienced team member for underwriting support operations.
  • Mentor and support less experienced underwriting support staff through coaching, knowledge sharing, and guidance.
  • Assist with onboarding and training activities for new and existing team members.
  • Support development and maintenance of procedures, workflow documentation, and job aids.
  • Contribute to a positive culture of learning, development, and operational excellence.
  • Serve as a resource to team members regarding underwriting guidelines, risk evaluation, coverage analysis, and underwriting best practices

Compliance, Documentation & Quality

  • Ensure underwriting support activities comply with established guidelines, procedures, and company standards.
  • Support quality, audit, and process consistency initiatives across underwriting support operations.
  • Identify recurring issues, trends, and opportunities for quality improvement.
  • Maintain accurate and complete underwriting documentation and records.
  • Protect the confidentiality of customer and company information

Knowledge Development & Contribution

  • Maintain advanced knowledge of insurance products, policy forms, underwriting support processes, and underwriting workflows.
  • Apply and continue developing advanced underwriting knowledge, including risk evaluation, coverage analysis, underwriting guidelines, complex account review, and underwriting support operations.
  • Participate in projects, initiatives, and process improvement efforts designed to enhance service, quality, and operational effectiveness.
  • Provide recommendations to improve workflows, procedures, and underwriting support effectiveness.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

Operational Excellence & Adaptability

  • Meet established service, productivity, quality, and timeliness expectations.
  • Effectively manage competing priorities and support departmental workload needs.
  • Promote consistency, professionalism, and accountability across underwriting support activities.
  • Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability in response to changing business needs, priorities, and processes.
  • Support process improvements and change initiatives that strengthen underwriting support operations.

..

 

SCOPE & DECISION-MAKING AUTHORITY

  • Account Scope: Advanced underwriting support activities, renewal preparation, endorsement review, policy servicing, and designated small-account underwriting activities.
  • Complexity: Advanced underwriting support responsibilities combined with underwriting responsibility for designated accounts and transactions of increasing size and complexity within delegated authority.
  • Authority: Expanded authority for designated underwriting support activities and underwriting responsibility for designated accounts and transactions of increasing size and complexity within delegated authority.
  • Decision-Making: Exercises judgment on assigned accounts, endorsements, and transactions within established guidelines and delegated authority while providing guidance to others and escalating higher-risk, more complex, or out-of-authority situations appropriately.
  • Supervision: Functions independently and provides mentoring, training, and technical support to team members without formal supervisory responsibility.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Post-secondary education preferred.
  • Recognized insurance education or coursework is desirable.
  • Typically 3-5 years of insurance experience with demonstrated progression in underwriting support, policy administration, policy processing, underwriting operations, or related functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, train, and support the development of others.

Technical Knowledge

  • Advanced knowledge of insurance products, underwriting concepts, policy forms, underwriting support processes, and underwriting workflows.
  • Understanding of risk review, coverage considerations, and underwriting support activities.
  • Ability to review documentation, identify issues, and support underwriting decisions within established authority.
  • Proficiency with company systems, applications, and technology supporting underwriting operations

Skills & Abilities

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to train, mentor, and support others.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and complex assignments.
  • Demonstrated leadership through influence and expertise.
  • Commitment to continuous learning, professionalism, and operational excellence.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & TRAVEL

  • Work is performed in a professional office or remote/hybrid environment, consistent with organizational policy.

Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to be allinclusive. Employees may be asked to perform other duties as assigned. Duties and scope may vary by product line or Center of Excellence while maintaining core underwriting responsibilities.

Quick facts

  • Pay: $92,200 to $152,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: New York, NY
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$92,200.00 - $152,000.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers Environmental group provides environmental liability coverage tailored to the needs of businesses such as manufacturers, laboratories, colleges, and contractors. The Account Executive (AE), Environment will partner with agents and brokers to provide coverage for new and renewal business based on customers' needs. As an AE, you are decisive, detail-oriented, and know how to build relationships internally and externally to drive results. Your ability to assess risk and sell our products will contribute to the profitability and success of Travelers.

As of the date of this posting, Travelers anticipates that this posting will remain open until 01/04/27.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned book of business.
  • Underwrite and skillfully negotiate customer accounts to minimize risk and maximize profitability.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales plans and identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Foster and maintain relationships with external partners by regularly meeting in person with agents and brokers to market and sell Travelers products with a goal of writing and retaining accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to such meetings.
  • Identify and capture new business opportunities using consultative marketing and sales skills.
  • Develop and execute agency sales plans. Execute region/group sales plans.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Three to five years of relevant underwriting experience with experience in environmental liability.
  • Knowledge of environmental liability products, the regulatory environment, and the local insurance market.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to proactively identify underwriting, marketing, or financial challenges and analyze available information to make timely decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.
  • Communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate with agents and brokers.
  • CPCU designation.

What is a Must Have?

  • Two years of underwriting, claim, operations, risk assessment, actuarial, sales, product, or finance experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Full job description

We are seeking an Underwriting Intern to join our team!


The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth.


The Underwriting Intern will support the Underwriting team by assisting with risk analysis, portfolio management, reporting, and underwriting processes that help drive informed business decisions and profitable growth. This role offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in insurance underwriting, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration while developing foundational skills for a career in underwriting and risk management.


Underwriting Analysis & Development (80%)

  • Assist the Underwriting team with data collection, analysis, and reporting of key underwriting and portfolio performance metrics.
  • Support the review and evaluation of underwriting results, trends, risk characteristics, and financial performance.
  • Assist in the preparation of underwriting reports, presentations, and business insights for internal stakeholders.
  • Conduct research and analysis to support underwriting strategies, pricing initiatives, and risk management decisions.
  • Help identify opportunities for process improvements and support the development of more efficient underwriting practices.
  • Utilize reporting and analytical tools to manage and interpret underwriting data in support of various projects.
  • Collaborate with underwriting, finance, product, and operations teams to support business objectives.

Project Management & Continuous Improvement (20%)

  • Participate in team meetings and brainstorming sessions to support underwriting initiatives and business solutions.
  • Assist in documenting underwriting processes, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
  • Support special projects related to portfolio management, risk assessment, business analytics, and operational improvements.
  • Contribute to process mapping and workflow optimization efforts.

Learning & Development Opportunities

In this role, the intern will have the opportunity to gain experience, enhance skills, and develop competencies that prepare them for future underwriting and risk management roles, including:

  • Exposure to a corporate insurance and underwriting environment
  • Understanding of underwriting principles and risk evaluation
  • Critical thinking and analytical problem-solving skills
  • Advanced use of data analysis and reporting tools
  • Experience working with business performance metrics and portfolio analysis
  • Ability to develop business recommendations supported by data and research
  • Experience presenting findings and insights to stakeholders
  • Exposure to cross-functional collaboration and business decision-making

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years completed and currently enrolled in a 3rd or 4th year undergraduate program in Risk Management, Finance, Business Management, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Master's degree candidates will also be considered.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Experience with Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, and basic modeling.
  • Interest in insurance, underwriting, risk assessment, and business analytics.

Other Skills

  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Professional demeanor and positive attitude.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Ability to learn new systems and applications quickly.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and making sound recommendations based on available information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong computer skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Experience using data visualization or analytical tools (Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar) is a plus.
  • Coursework in insurance, risk management, finance, statistics, or related disciplines preferred.

Remote Opportunity

Paid Internship: $22/hour

Start Date: 5/17/2027
End Date: 8/7/2027


Note: You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full time basis.

Description

We are seeking an experienced Middle Market Senior Underwriter to underwrite commercial property & casualty risks in the middle market segment. As an individual contributor, you will make analytical, data-driven underwriting decisions within delegated authority, with limited guidance from leadership. You will evaluate and price moderately complex to complex accounts, manage broker and client relationships, and help shape product and portfolio strategy for your book of business.

To be considered for this role, candidates must reside within the specified geographic location. This position requires regular in-person visits with local brokers and agents, so remote hires outside the designated territory cannot be accommodated.

Key Responsibilities

  • Underwrite middle market commercial accounts within assigned authority by assessing submissions, reviewing coverage terms, exposures, loss history, financials, and supporting information to determine accept/decline, terms, and pricing.
  • Make independent, data-driven decisions on risk selection and pricing consistent with underwriting appetite and profitability objectives.
  • Coordinate referrals for accounts above individual authority or that require specialized support.
  • Manage a portfolio of brokers, agents, and insureds:
  • Maintain and grow relationships with producing brokers and agents; act as a visible Liberty representative in the market.
  • Develop targeted broker strategies to source profitable middle market business and expand market share.
  • Provide timely, clear responses to brokers and clients; negotiate coverage and terms while protecting portfolio profitability.
  • Underwrite higher-limit, complex, or unusual submissions typical to middle market clients (specialty exposures, large single-location risks, multi-location schedules, or industry-specific hazards).
  • Engage internal partners (Claims, Actuarial, Risk Control, Legal) to structure appropriate terms and risk mitigation plans.
  • Mentor and coach junior underwriters and new hires on middle market underwriting practices, decision-making, and Liberty processes
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 2.5 years, typically 3 or more years, of progressive underwriting experience and/or other related experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process, and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

What Is the Opportunity?

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in September. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role. Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The Bond & Specialty Insurance (BSI) Underwriting Internship Program provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand experience, receive valuable on-the-job training and learn more about the property & casualty insurance industry. What exactly is an Underwriter? Insurance is the contractual transfer of financial risk from one party to another. Underwriters (Account Executives) are the heart of the insurance process, gathering and researching pertinent information and then using finely tuned analytical skills to evaluate the acceptability of business and institutional risk. However, underwriters are more than just analysts - they are the core relationship builders with our agents and clients. They are responsible for managing a profitable portfolio of business through our distributing agents and brokers. An underwriting career includes a dynamic blend of analytical and marketing skills - it's challenging, stimulating and a superb career choice. BSI provides management liability, professional liability and surety to businesses of all sizes. It also provides traditional property casualty coverages to financial institutions, and is organized into six separate and distinct business units which include: Commercial Surety (protects a third party from the failure of an insured to perform or fulfill an obligation); Construction Services (insuring the bond between contractors and clients); Financial Institutions (insurance for community banks, credit unions, insurance companies, investment advisors and large depository & non-depository institutions); Private/Non Profit Liability (insurance products for private companies and non-profit institutions); Professional Liability (coverage protects against liability claims for negligence, errors and omissions in the performance of professional services; and Public Company Liability (insurance products crafted to address the diverse management liability exposures faced by today's public companies.) Positions last approximately 10-12 weeks beginning in late May/early June and ending in mid-August. Housing assistance is not provided.

What Will You Do?

  • Each intern will be expected to complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program. In addition, there are core assignments and a designated coach to further develop interns' knowledge of insurance underwriting, sales and marketing.
  • Learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • Participate in the Enterprise Internship experience which includes Executive Speaker Series, Networking events, and Rising Senior Intern Symposium.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred), Management, Marketing, Risk Management and Insurance.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

What is a Must Have?

  • Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor's degree.

Description

We are seeking a Senior Underwriting Manager to oversee our Major Accounts Property portfolio in the Central Region. In this role, you will be responsible for managing a team of underwriters focused on complex monoline property accounts with a minimum Total Insured Value of at least $100 million. You will guide, mentor, and develop your team, ensuring they have the tools and resources needed to succeed while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.

Your responsibilities will include analyzing and approving underwriting decisions for large single carrier admitted property accounts by evaluating property exposures, hazards, financial information, requested coverages, loss history, pricing targets, and desired program structures to determine appropriate terms and conditions. You will work closely with Risk Engineering to enhance underwriting processes and strategies, ensuring a profitable book of business, while cultivating and maintaining strong relationships with producers and customers to drive growth and retention.

Additionally, you will contribute to the development and execution of underwriting strategies that align with overall business objectives and market trends. To excel in this role, you will need to maintain the highest level of knowledge in the large property space. Sharing insights and best practices with your team and other stakeholders will be essential to sustain and elevate overall performance.

Responsibilities

  • Drives a culture of underwriting excellence across entire portfolio. Drives change initiatives within the team.
  • Maintains a visible external profile and excellent relationships with external brokers/agents, partners and stakeholders, leveraging these relationships to help the team achieve their goals and expand their own networks.
  • Acts as a point of escalation/referral on particularly tricky or novel underwriting decisions and upholds and exemplifies Liberty`s value proposition across the business and market.
  • May cover for manager where required. Accountable for the performance of a portfolio (or part thereof) within a sub-segment of business underwritten by the team.
  • Specific technical responsibilities (e.g., related to planning, portfolio management, marketing, product development etc.) will differ in different parts of GRS.
  • May continue underwriting specific policies and delivering the work of an Underwriter.

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex analyses and information
  • Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with internal and external partners required
  • Must possess the following skills, abilities and attributes: strong leadership skills, development of people, strategic thinking, sustained effective portfolio management and profitable growth, communications skills, decision-making skills, results-oriented, industrious, innovative, problem-solving skills, coaching and mentoring skills, and negotiating skills

Job.JobTitle: Bond & Specialty Underwriting Professional Development Program (BSI UPDP) Internship
Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The hourly salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual hourly rate for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards. 

Salary Range

$25.00 - $26.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in September. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role. Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The Bond & Specialty Insurance (BSI) Underwriting Internship Program provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand experience, receive valuable on-the-job training and learn more about the property & casualty insurance industry. What exactly is an Underwriter? Insurance is the contractual transfer of financial risk from one party to another. Underwriters (Account Executives) are the heart of the insurance process, gathering and researching pertinent information and then using finely tuned analytical skills to evaluate the acceptability of business and institutional risk. However, underwriters are more than just analysts - they are the core relationship builders with our agents and clients. They are responsible for managing a profitable portfolio of business through our distributing agents and brokers. An underwriting career includes a dynamic blend of analytical and marketing skills - it's challenging, stimulating and a superb career choice. BSI provides management liability, professional liability and surety to businesses of all sizes. It also provides traditional property casualty coverages to financial institutions, and is organized into six separate and distinct business units which include: Commercial Surety (protects a third party from the failure of an insured to perform or fulfill an obligation); Construction Services (insuring the bond between contractors and clients); Financial Institutions (insurance for community banks, credit unions, insurance companies, investment advisors and large depository & non-depository institutions); Private/Non Profit Liability (insurance products for private companies and non-profit institutions); Professional Liability (coverage protects against liability claims for negligence, errors and omissions in the performance of professional services; and Public Company Liability (insurance products crafted to address the diverse management liability exposures faced by today's public companies.) Positions last approximately 10-12 weeks beginning in late May/early June and ending in mid-August. Housing assistance is not provided.

What Will You Do?

  • Each intern will be expected to complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program. In addition, there are core assignments and a designated coach to further develop interns' knowledge of insurance underwriting, sales and marketing.
  • Learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • Participate in the Enterprise Internship experience which includes Executive Speaker Series, Networking events, and Rising Senior Intern Symposium.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred), Management, Marketing, Risk Management and Insurance.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

What is a Must Have?

  • Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor's degree.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

We are committed to providing accommodation to persons with disabilities. If you require accommodation during the recruitment or interview process we will work with you to accommodate your needs.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

What Is the Opportunity?

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in October. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role. Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Are you curious by nature? Do you enjoy managing relationships and employing your critical thinking skills? Underwriters perform the critical function of evaluating the acceptability of risk and determining appropriate pricing for insurance products. The Business Insurance (BI) Underwriting Professional Development Internship Program provides students with an amazing opportunity to gain exposure to this critical function at Travelers. The 10-week program (running from early June to mid-August) provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand commercial insurance underwriting experience, receive valuable on-the-job training, and learn more about the property and casualty insurance industry from industry professionals. Given that, we are seeking interns that are serious about entering the insurance industry and who are excited about the prospect of making underwriting their future career choice. This role is a potential pathway to our full-time Underwriting Professional Development Program (UPDP). Housing assistance is not provided.

What Will You Do?

  • Within your assigned business unit, each intern will be given a designated coach and be expected to:
  • Complete core assignments and training modules geared toward insurance and underwriting principles.
  • Participate and complete self-paced professional development courses in time management, presentation skills, and other key areas.
  • Complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program at the discretion of your manager. You may work independently or with other interns and will be asked to present your findings to local leadership. Sample projects include a territorial risk assessment to determine profitability and underwriting opportunities as well as a business process analysis to determine underwriting gaps.
  • Learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • Learn about other areas at Travelers such as Risk Control, Claims, and related corporate functions. Interns may also engage in agency visits with Account Executives.
  • Participate in the Enterprise Internship experience which includes Executive Speaker Series, Networking events, and Rising Senior Intern Symposium.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred), Management, Marketing, Risk Management and Insurance.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

What is a Must Have?

  • Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor's degree.

What Is the Opportunity?

Technology & Life Sciences offers a wide array of products to technology software and service providers, electronics manufacturing companies as well as medical technology and pharmaceutical companies. The Account Executive Officer (AEO), Technology will partner with agents and brokers to provide coverage for new and renewal business based on customers' needs. This role is seen as a technical resource. As an AEO, you are decisive, detail-oriented, and know how to build relationships internally and externally to drive results. Your ability to independently assess complex risk and sell our products in challenging markets will contribute to the profitability and success of Travelers.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned book of business.
  • Underwrite and skillfully negotiate complex customer accounts to minimize risk and maximize profitability.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales plans and identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Foster and maintain relationships with external partners by regularly meeting in person with agents and brokers to market and sell Travelers products with a goal of writing and retaining accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to such meetings.
  • Identify and capture new business opportunities using consultative marketing and sales skills.
  • Independently develop and execute agency sales plans and frequently partner with your Managing Director (MD) to develop region/group sales plans.
  • May assist in the training and mentoring of less experienced Account Executives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Six to eight years of relevant underwriting experience with experience in commercial lines.
  • Deep knowledge of commercial lines products, the regulatory environment, and the local insurance market.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to proactively identify underwriting, marketing, or financial challenges and analyze available information to make timely decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate in difficult situations with agents and brokers.
  • CPCU designation.

What is a Must Have?

  • Four years of underwriting, claim, operations, risk assessment, actuarial, sales, product, or finance experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.

Company Details

W.R. Berkley Corporation is a Fortune 500 Company, listed on the New York Stock Exchange. The Company is made up of dedicated and passionate people committed to delivering the highest quality insurance products and services to specialized markets worldwide.

Our culture is one of innovation, creativity and teamwork. Our team is highly motivated, passionate about our business, and deeply experienced in developing and delivering product and service solutions in the life science marketplace. You will join a highly respected team of experienced, successful professionals with deep expertise in this market as they build the company of the future.

At Berkley Life Sciences, we insure the future of life science innovators today. We do so by serving as a preferred market for the life science industry around the globe, offering a broad range of sophisticated property & casualty products and services designed to meet our customers' individualized needs.

The company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Berkley Life Sciences professionals cohesively respond to the unique challenges faced by our life science customers. We are looking for talented and dedicated professionals to join our team.

Company URL: https://berkleyls.com/

Responsibilities

This role, a key contributor within the Berkley Life Sciences organization, is responsible for developing and executing a strategic vision that enables the long-term profitable growth of all products within the organization. This role serves as a strategic connector between field underwriting teams, senior management, and external broker partners, ensuring alignment, consistency, and momentum across territories. This includes developing the annual operating plan objectives (top and bottom line) and long-term strategic plan along with a focus on tactical broker / producer development planning. Additionally, this position has direct management of other underwriting leaders as well as responsibility for the team and its results.

In strategic alliance with the SVP, Underwriting Officer

  • Coach, mentor and develop team by establishing clear goals and providing regular feedback as well as training and career development opportunities; empower UW leaders to assume responsibility for their functions within the team.
  • Provide leadership and direction to the team in order to meet the goals for new business, retention, rate and customer service. Act as a catalyst for field activity, encouraging travel and proactive business development.
  • Build team confidence through training, coaching, and field presence.
  • Distribution management and expansion. Identify, develop and grow a knowledgeable producer population with an appropriate split between retail and wholesale channels.
  • Responsible for results of the team; review results with the CUO; proactively offer suggestions to improve performance and/or remove obstacles as necessary.
  • Cycle management- devise strategies and protocols to grow profitably during all market cycles.
  • Support the team to build strong relationships with brokers to ensure you meet or exceed financial goals including growth, profit, retention, and new business. Manage senior-level relationships with key brokers.
  • Portfolio management to reflect an appropriate balance between segments and diversification of line of business
  • Stay current with all compliance, procedural and workflow changes.
  • Work collaboratively and effectively with underwriting associate, operations, legal, home office underwriting and claims. Maintain and evolve the structural framework implemented across the underwriting teams.
  • Engage in innovation initiatives, product launches, marketing campaigns and short-term projects as appropriate to contribute positively towards success of the overall team and company.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of 10 years of package lines including auto, property, workers compensation, umbrella and premises operations experience.

  • Products liability claims made experience a plus.
  • Life Science experience a plus While Life Sciences experience is valued, it is not required. We welcome candidates with strong underwriting and leadership experience from other industry segments and will provide the training and support needed to build expertise in the Life Sciences market.

Technical Skills and Competencies

  • Coaches and Motivates Others

  • Innovation and Initiative

Additional Qualifications

You invest time in mentoring others, recognize potential, encourage growth through feedback and stretch opportunities, and consistently develop talent that delivers results.
  • Strong sales acumen. You bring a confident, client-focused presence and a passion for winning business. You understand customer needs, build trust quickly, and consistently deliver results.
  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills. Your communication style is flexible to the situation. You communicate clearly and with a purpose.

  • You have a proven history of building and maintaining strong business relationships with insureds, agents & brokers.

The Role at a Glance

As the COLI BOLI Insurance Consultant for Lincoln's Executive Benefit's Underwriting Team, you will analyze and deliver on COLI BOLI ICOLI cases. The Corporate-Owned Life Insurance (COLI) Underwriter is responsible for evaluating mortality, financial, and insurable risk associated with corporate-sponsored life insurance programs. The role supports the issuance and management of COLI and BOLI cases by assessing underwriting evidence, applying carrier guidelines, and making risk-based decisions that support profitable growth while maintaining regulatory compliance. Responsibilities often include collaboration with sales, actuarial, legal, case management, and corporate clients

This is a developmental opportunity designed for someone who brings relevant experience and knowledge of the COLI, BOLI, or broader institutional life insurance marketplace and is interested in building deeper underwriting expertise. A traditional underwriting background is not required. Candidates may bring transferable experience from areas such as operations, product management, client service, implementation, relationship management, or other roles that provide meaningful exposure to COLI and BOLI programs.

What you'll be doing

  • Underwrite Corporate-Owned Life Insurance (COLI) applications, including corporate and institutionally sponsored programs.
  • Underwrite Guaranteed Issue (GI) and Simplified Issue (SI) COLI cases in accordance with approved program designs, eligibility criteria, and carrier guidelines.
  • Evaluate and assess complex financial, and corporate risks for executives, key employees, and eligible participant populations.
  • Analyze corporate financial statements, program structures, and plan designs to ensure alignment with underwriting standards, regulatory requirements, and risk tolerance.
  • Apply knowledge of Qualified Purchaser and Accredited Investor definitions in support of program eligibility, structure, and regulatory compliance.
  • Determine face amounts, and policy terms using sound underwriting judgment
  • Review and approve pre-issue and post-issue underwriting transactions, including policy changes, face amount adjustments, and other in-force underwriting requests.
  • Collaborate with Sales, New Business, Legal, Compliance, Actuarial, and Operations to support case design and execution.
  • Identify underwriting trends, emerging risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Maintain current knowledge of COLI regulations, underwriting philosophies, and market practices.

What we're looking for

Must-Have's

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to influence management/critical stakeholders
  • Analytical skills and close attention to detail is necessary
  • Ability to adapt quickly in a changing work environment

Nice-to Have's

  • Experience working with corporate owned life insurance (COLI) and/or bank owned life insurance (BOLI) programs
  • Strong understanding of the institutional life insurance marketplace
  • Experience in underwriting, operations, product management, client service, implementation, relationship management, or a related area

Applications for this position will be accepted through December 31, 2026, subject to earlier closure due to applicant volume.

At Lincoln Financial, we love what we do. We make meaningful contributions each and every day to empower our customers to take charge of their lives. Job Summary

Provides life underwriting guidance and support to agents throughout the application and underwriting process. Applies expertise in underwriting philosophies, requirements, workflows, and policy provisions to explain requirements and decisions, address complex inquiries, and help agents understand next steps. Facilitates communication between agents and underwriting resources to support case progression and an effective service experience.

Essential Job Functions

Responds to underwriting-related inquiries from agents regarding application status, case requirements, underwriting processes, policy provisions, and other insurance matters. Minimum three years of experience in customer service is required. Minimum one year of experience with life insurance and underwriting required.

Demonstrated customer service skills. Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Demonstrated written communication skills. Demonstrated problem solving skills. Demonstrates a high level of accuracy, even under pressure. Ability to simultaneously handle multiple priorities. Possesses strong technical aptitude.

Put your Insurance Experience to work – FROM HOME!

At WAHVE, we value significant insurance experience and want to revolutionize the way people think about phasing into retirement by offering qualified candidates the opportunity to continue their career working from home. As we say – retire from the office but not from work. Our unique platform provides you with real work/life balance and allows you to choose a full or part-time work schedule while continuing to utilize your insurance expertise in a remote, long-term position which includes company benefits!

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WAHVE

We created a welcoming place to work with friendly and professional leadership. We are known for the great care we take with our staff and our clients. We are passionate and determined about delivering the best customer service, preserving insurance industry knowledge, and making a difference by the work that we do.

WHAT WE ARE SEEKING

We have assignments available to help our insurance carrier in Inland Marine Underwriter – Jewelers Block positions.

Responsibilities include:

  • Serve as the lead technical underwriter for complex Jewelers Block, Fine Art and Specie risks, exercising broad underwriting authority and independent judgment to evaluate, price, and structure profitable accounts.
  • Analyze sophisticated exposures, develop creative underwriting solutions, and confidently write risks that require advanced expertise, disciplined analysis, and sound risk management.
  • Build, manage, and optimize a profitable portfolio by applying pricing strategies, monitoring portfolio performance, evaluating loss trends, and adapting underwriting strategy to changing market conditions.
  • Cultivate and strengthen relationships with wholesale brokers, retail agents, carrier partners, and direct dealer channels to expand profitable distribution opportunities and enhance market presence.

  • Ensure underwriting files, referrals and documentation meet the highest standards of technical quality, regulatory compliance, delegated authority requirements, carrier audits, and bordereaux reporting.
  • Mentor and coach underwriters by sharing technical expertise, strengthening underwriting discipline, and fostering the development of the next generation of specialty underwriting talent.

TO BECOME A WORK-AT-HOME VINTAGE EXPERT, WE REQUIRE

  • 25 years of full-time work experience
  • 10 most recent years of specialty P&C underwriting experience with deep technical expertise in Jewelers Block, Fine Art or closely adjacent Inland Marine
  • CPCU, AU or comparable professional designations

  • Retire from the office but not from work.

The Associate Account Executive (AAE) will build relationships with agents and brokers to provide insurance or surety solutions to customers. An AAE will analyze and evaluate risk to achieve business goals within an assigned book of business.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of a typically smaller assigned book of business.

Company Details

Berkley Aspire is passionate about making excess and surplus lines business easy to transact. We differentiate ourselves by continually innovating to bring market-leading technology and services to our agents and their clients.

From direct bill with installments, to not requiring renewal applications for 80% of our small business policies, we focus on making it easy, expeditious, and efficient for agents and consumers.

Berkley Aspire writes from small, minimum premium, policies to accounts over six figures. We offer General Liability, Property, Inland Marine and Excess policies through Berkley appointed agencies in 49 states.

Benefit Highlights
• Aspire offers Medical, Dental and Vision coverage. Our onsite Scottsdale, AZ Wellness Center and companywide Employee Assistance Program are free to employees and are here to support your overall well-being. Our flexible work schedule with a work-from-home day means you can balance work and life like a pro.
• Our Health Savings Accounts have automatic company contributions if you sign up, and we offer Flexible Spending Accounts, STD, LTD, life insurance policies, and more. Plus, we offer a 401(k) program, profit-sharing program, and stock purchase plan – investing in your future has never been so rewarding.
• We've got you covered with competitive paid time off, paid sick time, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. Plus, you get paid holidays, a floating holiday, and paid volunteer time – because giving back to the community is important to us at Aspire!
• Come grow with us! Level up with company sponsored conferences, tuition assistance, and industry-related education and exams. We have many internal promotional growth opportunities – because we believe in growing together.
• We believe in working hard and playing hard. We embrace team building and are enthusiastic about sponsoring fun activities inside and outside of the office. Our Plum Benefits program gives you cost-free access to thousands of exclusive travel and entertainment discounts – it's like a VIP pass to fun.

www.berkleyaspire.com

Located in our Scottsdale, AZ or West Chester, OH offices, the Account Manager services clients with insurance policies written for Berkley Marketplace trading partners with Berkley sister companies. This position is part of a dynamic team environment requiring high levels of collaboration and partnership.

  • Mentor and assist with training of more junior team members.

  • Service multiple lines of business including, but not limited to, Workers Compensation, Inland Marine, Professional Liability, Pollution Liability, Product Recall, Management Liability, and complex, specialty, industry-specific products.
  • Manage renewal activity for assigned book of business.
  • Enter and maintain policy transactions in Berkley Marketplace's Agency Management System.
  • Manage policy premium billings and accounts receivable.
  • Answer client questions via phone and email promptly and with professionalism.
  • Interact with external brokers and internal underwriters and other stakeholders to process service requests.
  • Ensure compliance with Surplus Lines regulations in the placement of Surplus Lines policies.
  • Complete agency appointments and contracts for new Berkley Marketplace trading partners.
  • Maintain and update agency appointments as needed.
  • Answer incoming phone calls and monitor email accounts and respond in a timely and professional manner to inquiries and communications.
  • Complete special projects assigned by management.

  • 5 or more years of insurance experience
  • Excess and Surplus lines experience is required
  • Property and Casualty insurance licenses are preferred
  • Strong understanding of insurance concepts and market forces
  • Strong customer service proficiency
  • Well organized with ability to understand priorities and meet deadlines
  • Good oral and written communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy and thoroughness
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite of applications (Word, Excel, etc.)
  • Strong results orientation, focusing on outcomes, delivering on commitment and deadlines
  • Teamwork, providing and welcoming open, honest, respectful, and constructive feedback
  • Technical Proficiency, ability to learn and apply new skills

Travel: Rare

Full job description


Description

We are seeking an experienced Middle Market Senior Underwriter to underwrite commercial property & casualty risks in the middle market segment. As an individual contributor, you will make analytical, data-driven underwriting decisions within delegated authority, with limited guidance from leadership. You will evaluate and price moderately complex to complex accounts (including high individual line sizes and unusual exposures in parts of North America), manage broker and client relationships, and help shape product and portfolio strategy for your line of business.

To be considered for this role, candidates must reside within the specified geographic location. This position requires regular in-person visits with local brokers and agents, so remote hires outside the designated territory cannot be accommodated.

Key Responsibilities

  • Underwrite middle market commercial accounts within assigned authority by assessing submissions, reviewing coverage terms, exposures, loss history, financials, and supporting information to determine accept/decline, terms, and pricing.
  • Make independent, data-driven decisions on risk selection and pricing consistent with underwriting appetite and profitability objectives.
  • Coordinate referrals for accounts above individual authority or that require specialized support.
  • Manage a portfolio of brokers, agents, and insureds:
  • Maintain and grow relationships with producing brokers and agents; act as a visible Liberty representative in the market.
  • Develop targeted broker strategies to source profitable middle market business and expand market share.
  • Provide timely, clear responses to brokers and clients; negotiate coverage and terms while protecting portfolio profitability.
  • Underwrite higher-limit, complex, or unusual submissions typical to middle market clients (specialty exposures, large single-location risks, multi-location schedules, or industry-specific hazards).
  • Engage internal partners (Claims, Actuarial, Risk Control, Legal) to structure appropriate terms and risk mitigation plans.
  • Mentor and coach junior underwriters and new hires on middle market underwriting practices, decision-making, and Liberty processes
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 2.5 years, typically 3 or more years, of progressive underwriting experience and/or other related experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process, and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Put your Insurance Experience to work – FROM HOME!

At WAHVE, we value significant insurance experience and want to revolutionize the way people think about phasing into retirement by offering qualified candidates the opportunity to continue their career working from home. As we say – retire from the office but not from work. Our unique platform provides you with real work/life balance and allows you to choose a full or part-time work schedule while continuing to utilize your insurance expertise in a remote, long-term position which includes company benefits!

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WAHVE

We created a welcoming place to work with friendly and professional leadership. We are known for the great care we take with our staff and our clients. We are passionate and determined about delivering the best customer service, preserving insurance industry knowledge, and making a difference by the work that we do.

WE ARE SEEKING

We have assignments available to help our insurance carrier, MGA, or wholesale broker clients in Middle Market Commercial Lines Underwriter positions - specifically with experience in the New England territory.

Well suited candidates in Commercial Lines will have job opportunities ranging across the following Property & Casualty sectors including General Liability, Professional / Management Liability, Property, Workers' Compensation, Commercial Auto, Umbrella, Cyber, Inland Marine, Surety Bond and/or Excess & Surplus commercial lines of business.

Responsibilities include:

  • Conduct accurate and thorough risk selection with proper classification of insureds.
  • Make critical underwriting decisions on risk acceptability, coverage alternatives, and pricing.
  • Manage a portfolio of new and/or renewal business with focus on book management.
  • Develop and maintain superior relationships with producers, brokers, and reinsurers.
  • Maintain accurate file documentation in accordance with company guidelines.
  • Achieve acceptable underwriting profit levels within assigned book of business.

TO BECOME A WORK-AT-HOME VINTAGE EXPERT, WE REQUIRE

  • 25 years of full-time work experience
  • 10 most recent years of Commercial Lines Property & Casualty insurance experience

BENEFITS OF BECOMING A WAHVE VINTAGE EXPERT

  • Health insurance based on eligibility.
  • 401(k) with a 4% match based on eligibility.
  • Voluntary Dental, Vision, Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D).
  • Retire from the office but not from work.
  • Eliminate the office stress and the commute.
  • Choose the work you would like to do now.
  • Available in either full or part-time schedules.
  • Utilize your years of insurance industry knowledge.
  • Be part of our dynamic yet virtualteam environment and connect with other experienced insurance professionals like yourself!

HOW TO GET STARTED

Click APPLY NOW to complete our simple preliminary profile. Be sure to include your preferred contact information as one of our Qualification Specialists will connect with you promptly.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!
